content.value_statement: Dart package conflicts can block builds and make upgrades difficult. This skill provides a controlled workflow to inspect constraints, update dependencies, and verify the resolved graph.
actual_capabilities: Explains Dart single-version dependency resolution and version lock.
Guides review of dart pub outdated results.
Distinguishes upgradable packages from packages requiring constraint changes.
Provides steps for targeted dependency upgrades and constraint tightening.
Describes surgical removal of one conflicting lockfile entry.
Verifies changes with Dart analysis, tests, and dependency inspection.
limitations: It does not inspect a project unless an AI tool is given project files and command output.
It cannot determine whether a package API upgrade requires manual code changes.
It does not replace review of package changelogs, security advisories, or licenses.
Lockfile edits may not be appropriate for every package source or workspace setup.

use_cases.title: Unblock a Flutter build
use_cases.description: Identify incompatible dependency constraints after dart pub get fails and select a narrow resolution path.

use_cases.title: Plan a controlled upgrade
use_cases.description: Use outdated-package results to separate safe compatible updates from changes that require new constraints.

use_cases.title: Stabilize CI dependencies
use_cases.description: Apply lockfile and verification practices to keep tested package versions consistent in continuous integration.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a resolution error
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain this dart pub get version-solving error in simple terms and list the first checks I should make.

prompt_templates.title: Review outdated packages
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this dart pub outdated output. Separate packages that are upgradable from packages that need pubspec.yaml constraint changes.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve one conflict
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me resolve this conflict between these pubspec.yaml constraints. Propose the smallest safe change and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Create an upgrade plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a staged Dart dependency upgrade plan from these pubspec files and test results. Include verification after each stage.

output_examples.input: A project cannot resolve http because direct and transitive constraints are incompatible.
output: Identify the direct constraint and the package imposing the transitive constraint.
Check whether a compatible http version exists.
Update the smallest necessary constraint, then run dependency checks and tests.

output_examples.input: dart pub outdated shows a resolvable minor update.
output: The update needs a pubspec.yaml constraint change.
Apply the new compatible lower bound.
Run dart pub upgrade, dart analyze, and dart test before committing the lockfile.

best_practices: Review dart pub outdated before changing version constraints.
Change one dependency group at a time and test after each change.
Commit pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock together after successful verification.
anti_patterns: Do not delete the full lockfile to bypass a single conflict.
Do not upgrade every dependency before identifying the constraint causing the failure.
Do not ignore analyzer or test failures after a dependency upgrade.

faq.question: What problem does this skill address?
faq.answer: It guides diagnosis and resolution of Dart and Flutter pub package version conflicts.

faq.question: When should I run dart pub outdated?
faq.answer: Run it before upgrades or when dependency resolution reports conflicts.

faq.question: What is the difference between Upgradable and Resolvable?
faq.answer: Upgradable fits current constraints. Resolvable may require changing one or more constraints.

faq.question: Should I delete pubspec.lock to fix a conflict?
faq.answer: No. Prefer targeted changes because deleting the full lockfile can update unrelated packages.

faq.question: Does this skill update package files automatically?
faq.answer: The skill provides guidance. Any file edits or commands depend on the AI tool and your approval.

faq.question: How do I verify a resolution?
faq.answer: Run dart pub deps, dart analyze, and dart test after updating dependencies.
